objective.text: The objectives of this investigation were to determine how rapidly a large scale fire grows in low-gravity and investigate the low-g flammability limits compared to those obtained in NASA normal gravity material flammability screening test.
objective.quote:
The objectives of this investigation were to:
(1) determine how rapidly a large scale fire grows in low-gravity and (2) investigate the low-g flammability limits compared to those obtained in NASA’s normal gravity material flammability screening test.

earth_benefits.text: Studying fire in small, sealed environments such as the Cygnus cargo supply vehicle benefits fire safety and prevention efforts on Earth, including inside mines, airplanes, or submarines.
